## Most-Request Features (features aspect, by volume)

- **Bulk playlist management** – 1,172 mentions; users want easier playlist editing, e.g. downloading from Liked Songs without visiting each album [#rv_1720665406393827611] and better search/recent-history [#rv_-597146201764703989].
- **Lyrics display** – 764 mentions, growing +16.8% recently; lyrics missing even on Premium [#rv_-4833432056662012900] [#rv_-4754561593287914996].
- **Offline / download limits** – 497 mentions, fastest growth (+62.2%); users want reliable offline listening [#rv_-483273387687376766] [#rv_-5730769431473763196].
- **More skips** – 325 mentions, +20.3% growth; frustration with limited skips per hour.
- **Audio quality** – 243 mentions, +23.0% growth.

Note: the top-counted "features" themes (Unexpected Song Playback, Premium Required for Full Playback, UI Glitches, Playlist Playback Mismatch) are mostly complaints about existing behavior rather than new feature requests.
